_readme: Site-specific embed providers for ReClip.
Copy this file to providers.json (next to app.py) and fill in your own hosts.
providers.json is gitignored, so real domains/endpoints stay out of the source tree.
Docker: providers.json is also dockerignored. Put your file at ./config/providers.json
(docker-compose mounts it read-only at /app/config and sets RECLIP_PROVIDERS).
Common fields:
name               unique id; also stored as the download's extractor tag
kind               resolver type: "json_stream_api" | "signed_file_host" | "link_list_page"
url_pattern        regex (case-insensitive) deciding which URLs belong to this provider
"json_stream_api" fields:
filecode_pattern   regex whose group 1 captures the media id from the URL
api_url_page_regex regex run over the embed HTML; group 1 = the API base the page declares
api_url_fallback   API endpoint used when the page declares none
id_key             payload key that receives the captured id (default: filecode)
payload            extra static JSON body fields sent with the request
fields             response mapping: media_url / title / thumbnail
"signed_file_host" fields (file page -> dl page -> metadata API -> signed CDN URL):
dl_link_regex      finds the download-page URL inside the file page HTML
direct_dl_pattern  matches a pasted URL that IS already a download-page link (optional)
data_id_regex      extracts the asset id from the download page HTML (group 1)
meta_api           POST {"id": <data_id>} here; expects {mediafiles, path, original}
sign_service       GET ?path=<urlencoded path>; expects {token, ex}
"link_list_page" fields (album/listing pages expanded into individual links):
item_href_regex    matched against absolute hrefs; matching ones become items
max_items          safety cap per page (albums fan out fast)
